# Diagram authoring

Find IDs in `service-index.csv` and metadata in `service-catalog.csv`. Services
CSV columns are `id,OfficialName,Abbreviation,Summary,Usage,Notes`; IDs must
match items.

Use canonical V1, the narrowest semantic group, and valid service scope.
Validate, render requested formats, and inspect containment, labels,
connectors, metadata bands, and pages. Examples and commands:
`reference.md` section `11`.
